chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Riba (usury/interest) occurs only in what is measured by volume or weighed.

key_terms.الرِّبَا: Usury or interest, specifically in the context of commodity exchange

ai.seo_question: What types of goods are subject to Riba according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* delineates the scope of Riba al-Fadl by restricting it to commodities measured by volume or weight, a view central to the Shia juristic debate on whether the prohibition extends to all six canonical items or only those with specific physical attributes. It provides the foundational evidence for distinguishing between Riba in sale (exchange of unequal quantities of the same commodity) and general market transactions, emphasizing that irregular goods are exempt from these strict proportional rules.
